invariants.rationale: The context parameter is expected to be non-null for coordinator and parallel job execution.
An instant time represents the commit or operation instant; it is generally required and expected to be non-null.
List of HoodieRecords to be upserted must be non-null for the operation to proceed.
If preppedRecords is not empty, its size is at least zero.
The instantTime string should be non-empty to denote a valid commit instant.
